episodes.synopsis: Did his dying wish transport Kongming to heaven or hell? He only know one thing for sure: The girl dressed as a devil has the voice of an angel!
episodes.title: Kongming Descends Upon Shibuya

episodes.synopsis: When a rival singer resorts to dirty tactics to get ahead, it’s up to Kongming to revive a mysterious, ancient strategy and bring about a decisive victory for EIKO!
episodes.title: Kongming Uses a Stratagem

episodes.synopsis: Who is Kongming, really? Kobayashi is starting to think the strange man’s previous victory was a fluke. Only the REAL Kongming could create something from nothing... right?
episodes.title: Kongming Learns of the Right Path to Take

episodes.synopsis: The enigmatic Kongming’s latest stratagem leaves Eiko feeling off-beat. After a night of carefully plotted partying in Roppongi, can the pair find their rhythm again?
episodes.title: Kongming Lights the Way

episodes.synopsis: Kabetaijin, an unrivaled freestyle rapper, quit the scene and fled into the shadows, but there is no foxhole deep enough to hide him from Kongming!
episodes.title: Kongming Busts a Rhyme

episodes.synopsis: Past and present collide when Kongming and Kabe face off in the most epic rap battle in history! Who will drop superior bars and walk away victorious?
episodes.title: Kongming’s Freestyle

episodes.synopsis: Eiko must impress an important music producer, but finding your voice is no easy tactical feat. Perhaps she’ll find a comrade in arms on the streets of Shibuya…
episodes.title: Plan for Peace Throughout the World, Vol. 1

episodes.synopsis: Eiko and Kabe are missing something — something others have but they don't. Under Kongming's watchful eye, each strikes out on a mission to discover what that something is.
episodes.title: Searching for Oneself

episodes.synopsis: Eiko and Nanami have struck an alliance, but opposing forces conspire to break them apart. Can they endure the enemy salvo, or will their truce collapse under the onslaught?
episodes.title: For the Populace

episodes.synopsis: While Kabe engages an old rival in a rematch, Eiko marches headlong into battle against her own inner adversary, and Kongming recalls peaceful days past.
episodes.title: Dreamer

episodes.synopsis: The climactic final battle is upon us! With Summer Sonia on the line, Kongming must devise the ultimate stratagem to bring about total victory and secure 100,000 likes.
episodes.title: Borrowing Arrows With Straw Boats

episodes.synopsis: It all comes down Kongming’s final gambit. Eiko will take to the stage in a direct confrontation with her friend-turned-rival, but will Nanami hear the song in Eiko’s heart?
episodes.title: Eiko’s Song
